excluded_paper_components: Public BTC/USDT Jan-Jun2024 training, July validation, fixed August-September test.
Wavelet denoising, XGBoost feature selection, large indicator grid and dropout are excluded.
Convolutional autoencoders omit the original encoder/decoder pool-upsampling stacks; latent channels are reduced.
Configurable bounded LSTM/FC widths replace original widths20/10; Conv outputs reduced.
Training uses minibatch Adam, training-only scaler, shuffled training windows and chronological validation checkpoint selection; bounded epochs are not the paper's convergence loop.
Training quality threshold is reported honestly; runtime pass is not a well-trained or profitable-model assertion.
Printed 10^-BCE proxy uses a different log base from conventional BCE; preserve it as a named paper proxy.
Theta=.5, next-open fills and per-fill costs are declared execution adaptations; no SL/TP bracket engine.
OHLC/price-like features use causal window-relative price normalization; volume uses window mean.
Analytic convolution/LSTM backpropagation matches the independent Scalar autodiff path and finite differences.
Validation influences checkpoint selection only, never gradients or scaler fitting; test is excluded from training request.
